estimatedDelivery.title: Estimated Delivery
estimatedDelivery.description: The estimated delivery date, if available.

found.title: Found
found.description: True if a matching order was located for this email and order number.

identityLocked.title: Identity Locked
identityLocked.description: True once this conversation is pinned to a verified email.

message.title: Message
message.description: Human-readable summary or not-found explanation - safe to relay to the customer as-is.

orderDate.title: Order Date
orderDate.description: The date the order was placed.

status.title: Status
status.description: Current order status (Draft, Processing, Shipped, Delivered, or Cancelled). Draft means saved but not submitted yet.

verifiedEmail.title: Verified Email
verifiedEmail.description: The email that matched this lookup. Empty when nothing matched.
